rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying that something almost does not happen or is hardly done.

example.jyutping: ngo5 gei1 fu4 m4 sik6 zou2 caan1

rows.note: Use this when one event happens immediately after another, as in “scarcely had ... when ...”.

example.english: I had scarcely sat down when someone called.
example.traditional: 我啱啱坐低就有人打電話嚟。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ngaam1 ngaam1 co5 dai1 zau6 jau5 jan4 daa2 din6 waa2 lai4

rows.note: Use this for an outcome that is unlikely or probably will not happen, rather than for something that almost never happens.

example.english: At this hour, you can scarcely find a taxi.
example.jyutping: gam3 je6 hou2 naan4 wan2 dou2 dik1 si2
